name: workflow
description: Stack-agnostic engineering workflow: a test-gated git/GitHub ship cycle, test-writing, ADR/CLAUDE.md doc sync, feature plan logging, a project scaffolder, and a house-rules conventions skill. Commands read concrete commands (test/run/setup) from the project's CLAUDE.md instead of hardcoding a stack. Scaffolds a generic AGENTS.md so Codex can be used Claude-Code-first for review, bug-fixes, and token-backup.
